instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right and a framed picture on your left, as the floor transitions from wood to dark grey tiles. Continue straight past a bedroom entrance on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right to enter the living room area, with a sofa and TV on your left and dining chairs on your right. Walk forward, passing a white door on your right. Stop in front of the coffee table and sofa, facing the large window.
